scenes.title: 01-mesh-distance-field
lines: This gray view is the engine demonstration with Mesh DistanceFields enabled.
Unlike the original material-color view, rocks and walls appear rounder and simpler.
As the camera moves, examine the representation of narrow gaps and broad walls together.
In the earlier diagram, the ray advanced using distance to the surface rather than reading triangle colors.
It is separate from Nanite cluster colors and cached lighting in the Surface Cache, so these different visualizations must not be conflated.

scenes.title: 20-lumen-interior-toggle
lines: The next example is an interior with windows.
Inspect the region near the bright windows separately from the wall behind the sofa and the ceiling.
A bright window does not establish sufficient indirect illumination throughout the room.
Identify the darkening transition and the bright state, then treat the following camera movement as a separate observation.
The source is not an exposure-locked measurement experiment.
It still provides a starting point for distinguishing directly illuminated regions from the other room surfaces.
Connect the storage and update structure explained earlier to this actual interior result.
